description: This PHP class 'GetModulesParams' defines parameters for retrieving module information via an API. It extends 'BaseParam' and provides methods for accessing various query parameters such as module name, fields, pagination, sorting, and filtering.

classes.name: GetModulesParams
classes.description: Defines and manages parameters for fetching modules in API v8.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the requested fields or null.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Returns pagination information, creating a new PageParams object if not set.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Checks whether the filter includes a deletion indicator.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures the parameters with allowed options using OptionsResolver.
